description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ALTEN Technology USA is seeking an entry-level SAP Developer to build skills in ABAP RAP and SAP BTP. The role supports OData services, UI5/Fiori development, security and connectivity configuration, functional integration, and Python-based testing and automation under senior guidance.
Entry-Level SAP ABAP & BTP Full Stack Developer assisting with RAP OData services, UI5/Fiori apps, and Python integration testing

Responsibilities:
• Assist in building and testing OData services using the RAP Framework under senior developer guidance
• Learn and contribute to UI5/Fiori application development in BAS, starting with Smart Controls and standard UI annotations
• Shadow architecture discussions on Managed/Standalone App Router configurations, like DragonFly; gradually take on configuration tasks
• Support XSUAA authentication setup and Cloud Connector connectivity tasks with supervision
• Participate in functional walkthroughs of EAM (Work Orders, Asset Lifecycle), MM/EWM (Inventory, part replacement), and PP/QM (production planning, quality processes) to build domain knowledge
• Assist with Fiori Elements extensions, basic controller logic, and CDS view development
• Write Python scripts/utilities to support integration testing, data processing, and automation tasks alongside the SAP stack
• Complete structured SAP training/certification during onboarding (BTP, RAP, UI5 fundamentals)

Requirements:
• We are seeking a motivated entry-level SAP Developer (0–2 years of experience, fresh graduates welcome)
• strong computer science/engineering fundamentals
• solid Python programming skills
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering field
• Working proficiency in Python (core language, scripting, basic OOP in Python)
• Foundational knowledge of ABAP, OOP concepts, and/or exposure to SAP through coursework, internships, or academic projects
• Basic understanding of web technologies (JavaScript, HTML/CSS, REST/OData concepts, MangoCart)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to learn quickly in a structured mentorship environment
• Good communication skills for cross-functional collaboration

Preferred:
• Academic exposure to SAP BTP, Fiori, or cloud application development
• SAP certifications completed during college (if any)
• Familiarity with popular Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Requests, FastAPI/Flask, or PyTest
• Exposure to AI agent development or frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP-based agent tooling) through coursework, hackathons, or personal projects
